provenance_note: Expected annual volumes before/after, mains water after greywater, litres per person and day, hot-water energy and CO2 saved, money saved, investment, simple payback per measure and in total, the payback ranking, greywater used and the hand-off flows were computed by bench-src/ref/gen_plbwatersaving.py, an independent Python implementation written from the published method (_plb/save/METHOD.md: persons x uses x days x litres per use, EU Ecolabel dual-flush mean, fill + flow x duration, uses shared between the rows of a class by count, the fixture inventory converted to one row per existing product with its own count, timed urinal cisterns 10 l/h single bowl or 7.5 l/h per bowl x 8760 h, hot share x 1.163 kWh/(m3 K) x dT / efficiency, simple payback only for a positive saving, greywater min(yield, flushing demand)), not from the page code; plus 14 external anchors worked by hand from Commission Decision 2013/641/EU (volumes and criterion 1 conformity), UK WSR 1999 Sch. 2 para 25, the heat capacity of water, one hand-worked office case and the hand-worked mixed-inventory cases of review Y6-2 (bench-src/ref/plbwatersaving_anchors.json). The product catalogue and the default uses are input data of the published method.
